determination: The component frameworks are established. No exact indexed match was located for the complete paired HINC classification. Historical priority remains unestablished.

sources.citation: Tian Yang, A Batalin–Vilkovisky algebra structure on the Hochschild cohomology of truncated polynomials
sources.role: ambient truncated-polynomial Hochschild, BV, and Gerstenhaber framework
sources.effect_on_hinc: The ambient Hochschild/Gerstenhaber computation is not new by itself.

sources.citation: Thorsten Holm, Hochschild cohomology rings of algebras k[X]/(f)
sources.role: explicit Hochschild cohomology rings for one-relation algebras
sources.effect_on_hinc: The exact dual-number ring identity must be tied to an appropriate characteristic-matching source or derived independently.

sources.citation: Michel Brion, On Algebraic Semigroups and Monoids
sources.role: general algebraic semigroup and monoid structure
sources.effect_on_hinc: Unit groups, components, curves, and general monoid language are established.

sources.citation: Michel Brion, On Algebraic Semigroups and Monoids, II
sources.effect_on_hinc: The odd reduced commutative idempotent behavior fits known theory; it is not independently novel.

sources.citation: Alexander Perepechko, Affine algebraic monoids as endomorphisms' monoids of finite-dimensional algebras
sources.effect_on_hinc: Obtaining unusual endomorphism-monoid geometry is not new by itself; the paper's variety convention does not automatically cover the nonreduced even scheme.

sources.citation: Reiner Hermann, Monoidal Categories and the Gerstenhaber Bracket in Hochschild Cohomology
sources.effect_on_hinc: Functorial bracket preservation is established machinery; the exact classifications remain instance-specific.

sources.citation: Alberto Elduque, Automorphism group schemes and Weyl groups of gradings
sources.role: scheme-theoretic automorphism groups over arbitrary fields
nonreduced automorphism schemes in positive characteristic
sources.effect_on_hinc: Infinitesimal and nonreduced symmetry schemes are established phenomena.

sources.citation: Benjamin Briggs and Lleonard Rubio y Degrassi, Stable invariance of the restricted Lie algebra structure of Hochschild cohomology
sources.role: positive-characteristic restricted operations on Hochschild cohomology
sources.effect_on_hinc: The manuscript must state whether strict endomorphisms preserve only cup and bracket or also the characteristic-two restricted/squaring operation.

limitations: Public web search cannot exclude unindexed or subscription-only sources.
Equivalent objects may appear under different generators or nonlinear coordinate changes.
A general theorem may imply HINC without naming the exact specialization.
Source-level MathSciNet, zbMATH, thesis, and non-English review remains required.
